1: // Orbit Escape – concise canvas game
2: // Canvas element assumed: <canvas id="game"></canvas>
3: (() => {
4:   const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
5:   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
6:   const WIDTH = canvas.width = canvas.clientWidth;
7:   const HEIGHT = canvas.height = canvas.clientHeight;
8:   const CENTER = { x: WIDTH / 2, y: HEIGHT / 2 };
9: 
10:   // Ship state
11:   const ship = {
12:     x: CENTER.x,
13:     y: CENTER.y - 50,
14:     r: 10,
15:     angle: 0,
16:     vx: 0,
17:     vy: 0,
18:     thrust: 0.1,
19:     rotSpeed: 0.07,
20:     fuel: 100,
21:   };
22: 
23:   // Game objects
24:   const debris = [];
25:   const fuelCells = [];
26:   let score = 0;
27:   let gameOver = false;
28: 
29:   // Utility helpers
30:   const dist = (a, b) => Math.hypot(a.x - b.x, a.y - b.y);
31:   const rand = (min, max) => Math.random() * (max - min) + min;
32: 
33:   // Populate obstacles and fuel
34:   for (let i = 0; i < 15; i++) {
35:     debris.push({ x: rand(0, WIDTH), y: rand(0, HEIGHT), r: rand(8, 15) });
36:   }
37:   for (let i = 0; i < 8; i++) {
38:     fuelCells.push({ x: rand(0, WIDTH), y: rand(0, HEIGHT), r: 6, collected: false });
39:   }
40: 
41:   // Input handling
42:   const keys = {};
43:   window.addEventListener('keydown', e => (keys[e.key] = true));
44:   window.addEventListener('keyup', e => (keys[e.key] = false));
45: 
46:   function update() {
47:     if (gameOver) return;
48:     // Rotation
49:     if (keys.ArrowLeft) ship.angle -= ship.rotSpeed;
50:     if (keys.ArrowRight) ship.angle += ship.rotSpeed;
51:     // Thrust
52:     if (keys.ArrowUp && ship.fuel > 0) {
53:       ship.vx += Math.cos(ship.angle) * ship.thrust;
54:       ship.vy += Math.sin(ship.angle) * ship.thrust;
55:       ship.fuel -= 0.2;
56:     }
57:     // Gravity toward center
58:     const dx = CENTER.x - ship.x;
59:     const dy = CENTER.y - ship.y;
60:     const distToCenter = Math.hypot(dx, dy);
61:     const gravity = 0.02 * (distToCenter / Math.max(WIDTH, HEIGHT));
62:     ship.vx += (dx / distToCenter) * gravity;
63:     ship.vy += (dy / distToCenter) * gravity;
64:     // Move ship
65:     ship.x += ship.vx;
66:     ship.y += ship.vy;
67:     // Wrap around edges
68:     if (ship.x < 0) ship.x += WIDTH;
69:     if (ship.x > WIDTH) ship.x -= WIDTH;
70:     if (ship.y < 0) ship.y += HEIGHT;
71:     if (ship.y > HEIGHT) ship.y -= HEIGHT;
72:     // Collision with debris
73:     for (const d of debris) {
74:       if (dist(ship, d) < ship.r + d.r) {
75:         gameOver = true;
76:         break;
77:       }
78:     }
79:     // Collect fuel cells
80:     for (const f of fuelCells) {
81:       if (!f.collected && dist(ship, f) < ship.r + f.r) {
82:         f.collected = true;
83:         ship.fuel = Math.min(ship.fuel + 30, 100);
84:         score += 10;
85:       }
86:     }
87:     // Lose if out of fuel
88:     if (ship.fuel <= 0) gameOver = true;
89:   }
90: 
91:   function draw() {
92:     ctx.clearRect(0, 0, WIDTH, HEIGHT);
93:     // Planet (center)
94:     ctx.fillStyle = '#2c3e50';
95:     ctx.beginPath();
96:     ctx.arc(CENTER.x, CENTER.y, 30, 0, Math.PI * 2);
97:     ctx.fill();
98:     // Ship
99:     ctx.save();
100:     ctx.translate(ship.x, ship.y);
101:     ctx.rotate(ship.angle);
102:     ctx.fillStyle = '#ecf0f1';
103:     ctx.beginPath();
104:     ctx.moveTo(ship.r, 0);
105:     ctx.lineTo(-ship.r, ship.r / 2);
106:     ctx.lineTo(-ship.r, -ship.r / 2);
107:     ctx.closePath();
108:     ctx.fill();
109:     ctx.restore();
110:     // Debris
111:     ctx.fillStyle = '#c0392b';
112:     for (const d of debris) {
113:       ctx.beginPath();
114:       ctx.arc(d.x, d.y, d.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
115:       ctx.fill();
116:     }
117:     // Fuel cells
118:     ctx.fillStyle = '#27ae60';
119:     for (const f of fuelCells) {
120:       if (f.collected) continue;
121:       ctx.beginPath();
122:       ctx.arc(f.x, f.y, f.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
123:       ctx.fill();
124:     }
125:     // HUD
126:     ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
127:     ctx.font = '14px sans-serif';
128:     ctx.fillText(`Fuel: ${Math.floor(ship.fuel)}`, 10, 20);
129:     ctx.fillText(`Score: ${score}`, 10, 40);
130:     if (gameOver) {
131:       ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.7)';
132:       ctx.fillRect(0, 0, WIDTH, HEIGHT);
133:       ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
134:       ctx.font = '24px sans-serif';
135:       ctx.textAlign = 'center';
136:       ctx.fillText('Game Over', WIDTH / 2, HEIGHT / 2 - 10);
137:       ctx.font = '16px sans-serif';
138:       ctx.fillText(`Final Score: ${score}`, WIDTH / 2, HEIGHT / 2 + 20);
139:     }
140:   }
141: 
142:   function loop() {
143:     update();
144:     draw();
145:     if (!gameOver) requestAnimationFrame(loop);
146:   }
147: 
148:   // Start the game
149:   requestAnimationFrame(loop);
150: })();

</content>
